entries.headline: Christian Yelich came close
entries.story: Christian Yelich went 1-for-4 with 1 RBI against Ryan Feltner and the Colorado Rockies. Closest call was a double in the 5th: "Christian Yelich doubles (17) on a line drive to left fielder Jake McCarthy, deflected by center fielder Cole Carrigg." The power showed up; the carry did not.
